claim.raw_value: Parent and Merger Sub shall use reasonable best efforts to take, or cause to be taken, all actions and do, or cause to be done, all things necessary, advisable or proper to obtain the proceeds of the Debt Financing contemplated by the Debt Commitment Letter on or prior to the Closing Date

satisfying on a timely basis, taking into consideration the timing of the Closing and the completion of the Marketing Period, and in a manner that will not impede the ability of the parties hereto to consummate the Merger promptly upon the Closing Date, all conditions to the funding of the Debt Financing set forth in the Debt Commitment Letter
using reasonable best efforts to negotiate and enter into definitive debt financing agreements on the terms and conditions contemplated by the Debt Commitment Letter
consummating the Debt Financing and causing the Debt Financing Sources to consummate their Debt Financing at the Closing
complying with its obligations under the Debt Commitment Letter and Definitive Debt Financing Agreements in a timely and diligent manner

Parent shall (i) use reasonable best efforts to arrange and obtain, as promptly as practicable, from the same and/or alternative debt or preferred equity financing sources, as applicable, alternative financing in an amount, together with the amount of Financing remaining available and cash and cash equivalent on hand at the Company and its Subsidiaries, sufficient to pay the Required Amount on the Closing Date
taking into consideration the timing of the Closing and the completion of the Marketing Period

attributes.why_unmapped: MARKETING_PERIOD: Parent's satisfaction of debt-financing funding conditions and its compliance with financing-agreement obligations are to be timed with regard to the Closing and completion of the Marketing Period.

claim.raw_value: alternative financing in an amount, together with the amount of Financing remaining available and cash and cash equivalent on hand at the Company and its Subsidiaries, sufficient to pay the Required Amount on the Closing Date, in each case, upon terms and conditions not materially less favorable, taken as a whole, than those set forth in the Debt Commitment Letter

attributes.why_unmapped: ALTERNATIVE_FINANCING: If the Debt Financing becomes unavailable or the Debt Commitment Letter or Definitive Debt Financing Agreements are withdrawn, repudiated, terminated or rescinded, Parent must arrange substitute debt or preferred-equity financing sufficient (together with remaining available Financing and cash on hand) to pay the Required Amount on the Closing Date, on terms not materially less favorable than the original Debt Commitment Letter.

claim.raw_value: amend, modify, supplement, restate, assign, substitute or replace the Debt Commitment Letter to add and appoint additional arrangers, bookrunners, underwriters, agents, lenders and similar entities

attributes.why_unmapped: LENDER_ARRANGEMENT: Without the Company's prior written consent, Parent may amend, modify, supplement, restate, assign, substitute or replace the Debt Commitment Letter solely to add and appoint additional arrangers, bookrunners, underwriters, agents, lenders and similar entities.

claim.raw_value: any related “market flex” provisions

attributes.why_unmapped: MARKET_FLEX: In assessing whether Alternative Financing terms are not materially less favorable than the Debt Commitment Letter, any related market-flex provisions are taken into account.

claim.raw_value: assist in preparation for and participate (and cause appropriate members of senior management of the Company to assist and participate) in a reasonable number of meetings
furnish Parent with the Required Information

assist Parent and the Debt Financing Sources in the preparation of customary bank information memoranda, lender or investor presentations, rating agency presentations, offering memoranda or private placement memoranda and other customary marketing materials in connection with the Debt Financing

cause the Company’s independent auditors to (A) provide customary comfort letters (including “negative assurance” comfort and change period comfort) with respect to historical consolidated financial information of the Company
using reasonable best efforts to obtain, to the extent applicable, consents of accountants for use of their reports in any materials relating to the Debt Financing and accountants’ comfort letters
at least four (4) Business Days prior to the Closing Date

provide all documentation and other information about the Company and the Subsidiaries of the Company as is reasonably required under applicable “know your customer”, anti-money laundering and beneficial ownership rules and regulations, including the USA PATRIOT Act
assisting Parent in obtaining any corporate or facility ratings from any ratings agencies contemplated by the Debt Financing
furnishing Parent with the Payoff Deliverables
providing Parent with drafts thereof at least three Business Days prior to the Closing

within 50 days after the end of any fiscal quarter that is not a fiscal year end, the unaudited consolidated balance sheet of the Company as of the end of such quarter and the related unaudited statements of income and cash flows
within 75 days after the end of any fiscal year, the audited consolidated balance sheet of the Company as of the end of such fiscal year and the related audited statements of income and cash flows

The Company will use its reasonable best efforts, and will cause each of its Subsidiaries to use its respective reasonable best efforts, to update any Required Information provided to Parent and the Debt Financing Sources as may be necessary
obtaining the Financing is not a condition to the obligations of the parties to consummate the Merger in accordance with the terms and provisions of this Agreement.
permanent take-out financing incurred in lieu of the bridge facility contemplated under the Debt Commitment Letter

attributes.why_unmapped: ALTERNATIVE_FINANCING: The cooperation obligations extend to permanent take-out financing incurred in lieu of the bridge facility contemplated under the Debt Commitment Letter, not only the financing as originally committed.

claim.raw_value: the parties acting as lead arrangers or agents for, and prospective lenders of, the Debt Financing

attributes.why_unmapped: LENDER_ARRANGEMENT: Meetings, calls and other financing activities are conducted with the lead arrangers, agents and prospective lenders of the Debt Financing.

claim.raw_value: Parent shall have notified the Company that it is commencing the Marketing Period on a date certain (in accordance with clause (A)(ii) of the definition thereof) in connection with the each such attempt to access the financing markets, in which case a Marketing Period shall be deemed to commence on such date specified for such attempt

attributes.why_unmapped: MARKETING_PERIOD: A Marketing Period is triggered by Parent's notice to the Company of a date certain for commencement, tied to each distinct attempt to access the financing markets.

claim.raw_value: Parent will reimburse the Company for any documented and reasonable out-of-pocket costs and expenses (including attorneys’ fees) incurred by the Company Group in connection with the cooperation of the Company Group contemplated by this Section (c)

attributes.why_unmapped: REIMBURSEMENT_OR_INDEMNITY: Following a valid termination of the Agreement, Parent reimburses the Company Group's documented out-of-pocket financing-cooperation costs and expenses upon request.

claim.raw_value: The Company Group and their respective Representatives will be indemnified and held harmless by Parent from and against any and all liabilities, losses, damages, claims, costs, expenses (including attorneys’ fees), interest, awards, judgments, penalties and amounts paid in settlement suffered or incurred by them in connection with their cooperation in arranging the Financing

attributes.why_unmapped: REIMBURSEMENT_OR_INDEMNITY: Parent indemnifies the Company Group and its Representatives for liabilities and expenses incurred in connection with their financing-cooperation activities, subject to carve-outs for materially false/misleading information and for fraud, bad faith, gross negligence or willful misconduct.

claim.raw_value: The Company shall use reasonable best efforts to deliver Payoff Deliverables with respect to the Repaid Indebtedness
at least one Business Day prior to the Closing
giving due regard to local market practice in connection with the repayment in full and termination of commitments of a debt facility in the applicable jurisdiction

attributes.why_unmapped: LENDER_ARRANGEMENT: Payoff delivery efforts account for local market practice governing repayment in full and termination of commitments of a debt facility in the applicable jurisdiction.
